page.layout: One printed page, text only in a single column of full width blocks; a signature mark "Ast" at the lower right of the text and faint show-through from the facing page at the right edge, not transcribed. No margin notes on this page.

main_text.p: Huc flecte, OSTORRODI, cursus, huc vela: Salutis Namq; tibi porta hic & tibi PORTVS inest.
STEPH. A CASTRO BELLO Verbi Dei Minister.
main_text.head: IN REFVTATIONEM OSTORRODII A Reuerendo & Clarissimo viro DN. IACOBO AD PORTVM compositam.
main_text.p: TItanum soboles superis indicere bellum Nititur, & Christum summa detrudere sede OSTERRODIDES sacri mysteria verbi Rodit, in æthereum vomicas eructat olympum. O parilis diuina Patris clementia nati: Quæ SAMOSATENICVM potis est tolerare piaclum! Suiphureos non ille globos, non feruidus ira, In caput vltrices Lernæum fulminat ignes. AD PORTVM reuocat placidus, non gurgite vasto In pelagum ductas voluit submergere puppes. Eripit è Scylla, clariq; tridente IACOBI In vada transmittit reduces, & littore ponit.
IOH. STEKIVS BASIL. I.V.D. In Academia Lausannensi Professor.
main_text.head: CLARISSIMO, SPECTATISSIMOQVE viro D. Domino IACOBO AD PORTVM, S.S. Theologiæ in Academia Lausannensi Professore doctissimo, sapientiss. Aduersus OSTOKRODII Samosateniani blasphemias scribenti.
main_text.p: INclyta Martis opus nostri Germania: cedis Terra nulli aliy manibus studissq; Minerue. Musarum domus es: Summum & quod culmen honoris, Religio horrendis seclorum vera tenebris Eripitur per te: per te lux ipsa salutis, Impietas quam dira suis includerat autris, Redditur in Christo. Fœlix, tua si bona nosses.

page.notes: Right edge shows partial text of the facing page (not transcribed). Several words in the Latin verse are doubtful, notably "Ostorrodii" and "Samosateniani"; "Ast" is the signature mark at the lower right. Line "Redditur in Christo" and final word "nosses" are read from the scan with some uncertainty.
